inv.desc_en:
Commercial space for sale, ideal for offices and studios. Just a few meters from Paseo Sant Joan, on Aragó Street. Located in a typical Eixample residential building. It is the only commercial space in the building. It has an area of approximately 256 m², rectangular and elongated, distributed into several areas used as an office, 2 bathrooms, and a more interior area with a first floor area of approximately 35 m² with large windows overlooking an interior patio and natural light. It has one window facing the street. IDEAL as a rental investment.
If you are interested in this property or would like to learn about our extensive product portfolio, please contact the Commercial Spaces department at Fincas Siglo XXI. We are a leading company in the sector with a long history. Our consultants will find the property that best suits your needs.
Reference: 002.12247.
